channel.title: StorageSavings: Blog
channel.description: Practical self-storage advice: how to pack a storage unit, what you can’t store, choosing between containers and units, and tips to save money on storage.

item.title: Container storage vs a storage unit: which is better?
item.description: Portable container storage or a self-storage unit? Compare convenience, access, cost factors and security to choose the right option for your move or project.

item.title: How to pack a storage unit (and fit more in)
item.description: How to pack a storage unit so everything fits, stays in good condition and is easy to find: boxes, labelling, furniture, stacking and the best layout.

item.title: What can’t you put in a storage unit?
item.description: The items storage facilities usually ban, from fuel and gas bottles to food, plants and pets, plus items that are allowed but better kept somewhere else.
